content.title: Why Demi Lovato, Husband Jutes Will Spend Their First Anniversary Apart
content.text: Why Demi Lovato, Husband Jutes Will Spend Their First Anniversary Apart0 seconds of 1 minute, 35 secondsVolume 0% Why Demi Lovato, Husband Jutes Will Spend Their First Anniversary ApartJordan “Jutes” Lutes makes Demi Lovato truly glow—sorry not sorry. And the duo—celebrating their first anniversary May 25—continue to prove they are that couple. Even though they'll be apart on their special day as they each tackle their own tours, Demi is confident distance will only make the heart grow fonder. After all, time has already done that. As she told E! News Erin Lim Rhodes in an exclusive interview, the Confident artist continues to “fall in love more and more every day." “I really thought on my wedding day—that was maxed out, like the most amount of love that you’ll ever feel for a person,” she admitted, “and then time goes by and you just form this connection that is so intimate and so fulfilling that you just fall completely more and more in love.” As for how their love keeps building up like a skyscraper? “We laugh, we have so much fun together,” Demi mused. “We stay up late laughing until we’re crying and it just feels like a giant sleepover with your best friend that you happen to be really, really attracted to.”And although her It’s Not That Deep tour—which kicks off April 13—will put a temporary pause on their daily sleepover, Demi affirmed Jutes has been “so supportive,” amid rehearsals, adding, “That’s all I can ask for.” Plus, Demi has a few secret weapons to provide support on the road, including Therabody JetBoots Pro, a nebulizer, plenty of lozenges and any oral products by TheraBreath. “We’ve partnered up and it’s just such a natural partnership with me because I love the products they’ve been part of my routine for years,” Demi explained. “My favorite is the TheraBreath Anti-Cavity Oral rinse in Sparkle Mint.”Amy Sussman/Getty ImagesDemi emphasized TheraBreath products are perhaps her most essential essentials. “I feel like feeling fresh just helps me show up as my best self, whether I’m in the studio or I’m about to perform in front of thousands of people,” Demi noted. “It’s about those get ready moments when I’m about to step on stage or in the studio or wherever, walk in the room that can make all the difference and when you feel fresh.” As she put it, “You feel more open and you feel more like yourself ready to take on anything.” For how Demi and Jutes take on anything together, keep reading…Instagram / Demi LovatoDecember 2022: Disneyland DateThe two kiss near Sleeping Beauty's Castle, four months after they went public with their romance.Instagram / Demi LovatoJanuary 2023: Happy New Year"Ended the new year like this," Demi wrote on Instagram, alongside pics of herself and Jutes on a trip to the San Gorgonio Wilderness in Southern California. "Wishing you all the best for 2023."Instagram / Demi LovatoFebruary 2023: Valentine's Day PDADemi shared this photo of the two kissing in a Valentine's Day post. "Life has become so enriched by you," she wrote on Instagram. "Life has become a dream come true. I’m so beyond grateful to have found my person in you. Falling asleep and waking up next to my best friend has made me so filled w joy I can’t even begin to explain.. my best friend, soul mate, twin flame, honeybun.. and the list goes on… the fun and laughs never stop w you.. I can be my weirdest goofy self and you never judge me." The singer continued. "Thank you for making me the happiest lil thing on earth.. happy first Valentines day together.. I love you @jutesmusic."Kayla Oaddams/WireImageFebruary 2023: Red Carpet DebutThe couple attends the Grammy Salute to Industry Icons Honoring Julie Greenwald and Craig Kallmanat in Beverly Hills.Kayla Oaddams/WireImageFebruary 2023: Kisses on the Red CarpetThe pair show PDA at the pre-Grammys event.Andrew D. Bernstein/NBAE via Getty ImagesFebruary 2023: Baller CoupleThe two attend the game between the Milwaukee Bucks and Los Angeles Clippers at Crypto.Com Arena in Los Angeles.Instagram / Demi LovatoSweet SelfieJutes kisses the singer.Instagram / Demi LovatoAll SmilesThe two share a sweet moment.Instagram / Demi LovatoSelfie SmilesThe two pose for a mirror selfie.Instagram / Demi LovatoPDA on the BeachThe two enjoy a romantic getaway.Instagram / Demi LovatoKissing in the OceanThe pair share an intimate moment.Instagram / Demi LovatoBeach BabesThe pair enjoy a romantic vacay.Instagram / Demi LovatoHomecoming King & QueenJust kidding. Demi wrote to her partner in an Instagram post. "I couldn’t be more excited to celebrate you because I couldn’t be more in love with your gorgeous, funny, sexy, talented self." She continued, "I’ve waited my whole life to find you and I can’t wait to celebrate so many more birthdays together.. you’re a literal dream come true and I’m so grateful to call you mine. Have the best birthday my love.. you deserve it, the world, and more!!!! Here’s to many more. I LOVE YOU."Alex Goodlett/Getty Images for Operation SmileApril 2023: Cool for the SpringThe two appear at Operation Smile's Celebrity Ski & Smile Challenge in Park City, Utah.Instagram / Demi LovatoJuly 2023: Philly-BoundJutes accompanies Demi on a quick tip to Philadelphia, where she played the Wawa Welcome America Festival over the July 4 holiday.Alex Goodlett/Getty Images for Operation SmileDecember 2023: EngagedJutes proposes to Demi in Los Angeles with a pear-shaped diamond engagement ring Dec. 16 and the duo celebrate with family members at a restaurant.Demi Lovato/InstagramJuly 2024: New Band Member The couple welcomed a new furry member to their family, a blonde-haired puppy. Demi wrote on Instagram to welcome him home, “Meet our new son pickle,” naming the pup after one of her favorite foods. Demi Lovato / InstagramDecember 2024: One Year EngagedDemi and Jutes celebrated their one-year anniversary of being engaged with heartfelt messages to one another on social media. “1 year of being engaged to my favorite person,” Jutes wrote on his Dec. 16 Instagram Stories. “I’m so lucky and can’t wait to marry u baby.”“My sweet angel,” Demi wrote back, “I love you infinitely and cannot wait to call you my husband!!! Happy 1 year of being engaged baby!!”Instagram/Demi LovatoFebruary 2025: Will You be my Valentine?The two celebrated their love on the Feb. 14 holiday, posting messages for their Valentine.“Jordan, I cannot WAIT to marry you!!” she captioned a series of photos together. “I’m obsessed with your heart, your love and your light. I can’t wait to grow old with you and start a family together.”TikTok/Demi LovatoMay 2025: The Butterfly EffectFor Demi, her romance with Jutes feels like fate. She posted a TikTok montage of cute moments with her beau, writing, “The butterfly effect is crazy because what if we were never set up in that writing session together.” Demi posted the video just two weeks before she and Jutes tied on the knot.For the latest breaking news updates, click here to download the E!
